reason: ₹22,000 is about two months of what we earn, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much when the crop or the work is not steady. We already have an inverter for the lights and fans, so I would rather buy a normal semi-automatic for half the price and run it when the power is on, or on the inverter.
objection: I am paying double just for a battery when I already have an inverter at home. If that battery goes bad after three years, it will be another big cost, and the dealer will take his time coming to fix it.
would_change_my_mind: If it came down close to ₹13,000-14,000, or the EMI was under ₹1,000 a month, so it costs about what a normal semi-automatic does.
